description: Send the same parameter more than once so the WAF/validator and the backend disagree on which value wins — bypassing filters, access control, or business logic. Load on "HPP", when a value is validated at one layer but used at another, or when a WAF blocks a payload you need to slip past. Signals: proxies/gateways in front of the app, duplicated params reflected inconsistently.
